# hi-usecase-discovery: hướng dẫn

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Sinh draft use case nghiệp vụ theo từng module: actor, quyền, rule, luồng, kết quả, ID, test và coverage.

**Mô tả gốc (EN):** Produce draft-only evidence-backed business use cases for one source module by inventorying files, classes, functions, entry points, registrations, indirect calls, and terminal effects, then reconstructing actors, permissions, rules, flows, outcomes, IDs, tests, and coverage. Do not use for technical behavior diagrams, API contracts, data models, or migration execution.

## Cách gọi

```text
/hi-usecase-discovery <module name> [output_dir] [parser_type] — draft-only
```

## Ranh giới

- Do not use for technical behavior diagrams, API contracts, data models, or migration execution.
- Caps protect tools; they never prove completeness.
- Never convert historical percentage targets into false claims.
